## Summary

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and related issue. Include screenshots for visible changes.

## Data flow and site isolation

For relevant changes, trace the request through authorization, database access and response. Explain how site isolation is preserved.

## Decisions and alternative

Explain significant choices and any added dependency. Compare an alternative when it helps the review.

## Verification

List exact commands, results and manual checks. Separate starting-commit failures from new ones.

## Limitations

List unfinished work, compatibility considerations and known edges. Assignment submissions should also report setup and implementation time separately.

## AI/tool assistance

State what assistance you used, what it produced and how you checked it.
